objective: One installer for Ultimate Keyboards with native home-row mods, combos, layers, and a bundled virtual-HID driver; no separate Karabiner-Elements installation.
acceptance: All five existing rule types execute in a deterministic native engine with tested tap/hold, combo timing, ordering, modifier ownership, and reset behavior.
Native helper uses IOHID device capture and the standalone signed virtual-HID driver, with no event-tap fallback or dependency on the Karabiner-Elements app.
Privileged mutations require the active console user and the signed Ultimate Keyboards app. Size limits, timeouts, driver readiness, device exclusion, and fail-open cleanup are enforced.
The application can report readiness, open the bundled installer, explicitly apply/enable rules, stop remapping, and maintain a bounded heartbeat lease.

A reproducible installer bundles our application/service and the pinned unmodified standalone driver, preserves licenses, checks signatures and compatibility, and protects existing shared installations.

Typecheck, frontend tests, native unit tests, service build, application build, packaging checks, and permitted runtime checks pass. Live capture, visual QA, signing, notarization, and external blockers are reported independently.
decisions: Reuse unmodified signed pqrs standalone DriverKit package v8.6.0, protocol7, driver1.8.0; never require full Karabiner-Elements.
Default capture scope is the built-in keyboard only. Require output readiness and explicit opt-in before seizure; exclude virtual output and preserve external split keyboards.
No installation or driver upgrades during implementation without inspecting compatibility and coexistence; no security protections disabled.
No Developer ID distribution certificate is installed locally. Build all possible artifacts and preserve this as an external distribution requirement.
Preserve the existing uncommitted recursive folder-permission fix in src/components/Settings.tsx.
